## Liberate Power

---


[Bi-entity Action Types](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=bientity_actions/liberate_power)

Lifts suppressions previously applied by [Suppress Power](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=bientity_actions/liberate_power) on the __target__ entity, allowing the restored powers to become active again immediately.

Type ID: `sync:liberate_power`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:liberate_power",
    "power": "my_datapack:flight"
}
```
Restores a single suppressed power.

```json
{
    "type": "sync:liberate_power"
}
```
Lifts all suppressions on the target at once.

```json
{
  "type":"sync:liberate_power",
  "power_sources":[
    "my_datapack:class_powers"
  ],
  "ignored_powers":[
    "my_datapack:passive_aura"
  ]
}
```
Restores all powers from `my_datapack:class_powers` except `passive_aura`.

x-intellij-html-description:
title: Liberate Power (Bi-entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Liberate Power

Bi-entity Action Types

Lifts suppressions previously applied by Suppress Power on the target entity, allowing the restored powers to become active again immediately.

Type ID: sync:liberate_power

Fields

Field Type Default Description
power Identifier optional A single power ID to liberate
powers Array of Identifier optional Additional power IDs to liberate
power_types Array of Identifier optional Factory-type IDs; all suppressed powers of these types are liberated
power_sources Array of Identifier optional Source IDs; suppressed powers granted via a listed source are liberated
ignored_powers Array of Identifier optional Power IDs that are never liberated, even if they match another filter
bientity_action Bi-entity Action optional Executed once for every power that gets liberated

Notes

  • If all filter fields are omitted, every active suppression on the target is lifted in one call.
  • Filter matching mirrors suppress_power: a power is liberated if it matches any filter, unless it is in ignored_powers.
  • Any suppressed powers that are no longer in the target's component (stale entries) are automatically cleaned up when no filter is set, or if they match an explicit power/powers entry.
  • Only powers that are currently suppressed are considered (non-suppressed powers are skipped).

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:liberate_power",
    "power": "my_datapack:flight"
}

Restores a single suppressed power.

{
    "type": "sync:liberate_power"
}

Lifts all suppressions on the target at once.

{
  "type":"sync:liberate_power",
  "power_sources":[
    "my_datapack:class_powers"
  ],
  "ignored_powers":[
    "my_datapack:passive_aura"
  ]
}

Restores all powers from my_datapack:class_powers except passive_aura.
